messages.subject: R954 report complete
messages.body: I reviewed the pinned SGLang QSA paths, local BF16 prefix source and hashes, prior evidence, SYCL subgroup semantics, and Intel matrix constraints, then wrote the assigned decision-support report. Two no-extra-barrier subgroup/register ownership layouts are coherent candidates; direct 32-cell fragment reduction conflicts with the current split-fragment ownership and requires cross-subgroup communication or a changed tile. Performance and numerical qualification remain for Main’s serialized implementation and measurement.
